November 25, 2026 | 8:27 am CST
Adentra acquires Canadian door & hardware distributor, AccessSMT

LANGLEY, B.C. — Adentra Inc., one of North America's largest distributors of architectural building products, has entered into a definitive share purchase agreement to acquire AccessSMT Holdings Ltd., a Canadian distributor of commercial doors, frames and hardware, access control and specialty building products. The acquisition is expected to close in December 2026 subject to approval under the Competition Act (Canada).

With roots dating back to 1928, AccessSMT supplies complete door opening packages for critical infrastructure, healthcare, education, institutional, commercial and multi-family projects. Its team supports general contractors, architects and building owners through the entire process starting with initial design and specification to fabrication, pre-assembly, delivery, installation and then provides ongoing service and maintenance.

AccessSMT employs approximately 490 people at 15 locations across six Canadian provinces and Washington State, including a dedicated door pre-assembly facility in Saskatoon, Saskatchewan. Its operating businesses include CP Distributors and McGregor Door & Hardware. After closing, AccessSMT will continue to operate under its existing branding as Adentra's Commercial Doors & Hardware business, led by Mike Barnes and AccessSMT's existing team.
